newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-THIRD SEED MARTINEZ OUSTED IN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-THIRD SEED MARTINEZ OUSTED IN OPEN.

text.p: Spanish third seed Conchita Martinez was ousted from Australian Open on Sunday after a stunning fightback by Sabine Appelmans of Belgium in the fourth round.
Martinez took the first set 6-2 against the Belgian 16th seed and served for the match at 5-4 in the second. But the Belgian produced the best comeback of the tournament to win 2-6 7-5 6-1.

It was the second time in two days that a leading Spaniard lost out to a Belgian in the women's draw. Number two seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario was bundled out in Saturday's third round by the unseeded Dominique van Roost.
Martinez appeared to be cruising through the match early on, sitting on the baseline waiting for Appelmans to make errors and dominating her own service games.

But Appelmans found a new lease of life in the second set and began to push the former Wimbledon champion around the court in temperatures of at least 40 degrees Celsius (104 Fahrenheit), which should have favoured the Spaniard.
Appelmans' next opponent will be Mary Pierce of France.
